method: Planning index for importer/distributor discovery at global scale. Counts are directory listing slots observed in Harpers product categories, not unique verified companies and not wine-data authority. Category counts can drift as the directory changes, so later live-page observations are retained separately instead of overwriting the index snapshot.

liveCategorySnapshots.note: Live category page differed from the 58-entry aggregate product index snapshot; both are retained as directory-version evidence.
A current crawl displayed 30 companies while nearby directory snapshots have shown 32 or 33; do not treat directory counts as immutable.

guardrails: Listing count does not equal unique importer count because businesses can appear in multiple country categories.
A directory listing is a discovery lead only and cannot establish wine, vineyard, legal, historical, genetic or technical facts.
Every candidate must be individually verified before source promotion.
Portfolio and technical-sheet availability must be inspected on the candidate's own site before observation ingestion.
